title: The Clever Rabbit
text:
Once upon a time, there was a small rabbit in a big forest. The rabbit was hungry, but the forest was dark. Every day, the rabbit looked for carrots.

One day, a fox saw the rabbit. The fox wanted to eat the rabbit. The rabbit thought fast and said, 'Look at the big lion behind you!' The fox ran away.

questions.text: What did the rabbit say to the fox?
options: Look at the big lion behind you!

questions.text: Why did the fox run away?
options: He thought a lion was near
He was too tired to run
He wanted to go to sleep

questions.text: What can the reader conclude about the rabbit?

paragraph_translations: Había una vez un conejo pequeño en un bosque grande. El conejo tenía hambre, pero el bosque era oscuro. Todos los días, el conejo buscaba zanahorias.
Un día, un zorro vio al conejo. El zorro quería comerse al conejo. El conejo pensó rápido y dijo: '¡Mira al león grande detrás de ti!' El zorro salió corriendo.
